card.line: Anathoth was a priests' city in the land of Benjamin, a few miles from Jerusalem, and it was the hometown of the prophet Jeremiah.

moments.title: A city for the priests
moments.text: Anathoth was one of four cities from the tribe of Benjamin given to the descendants of Aaron the priest, along with its pasturelands.

moments.title: Abiathar sent home
moments.text: King Solomon told the priest Abiathar to go back to his fields in Anathoth. He spared Abiathar's life because he had carried the ark before David and shared David's sufferings.

moments.title: Jeremiah's hometown
moments.text: Jeremiah was one of the priests in Anathoth. The word of the LORD came to him there and appointed him a prophet to the nations.

moments.title: Danger from his own people
moments.text: The people of Anathoth were seeking Jeremiah's life and told him not to prophesy in the LORD's name. The LORD said He would punish them.

moments.title: Jeremiah buys a field
moments.text: As the LORD had said, Jeremiah's cousin Hanamel asked him to buy his field in Anathoth. Jeremiah paid seventeen shekels of silver and signed the deed before witnesses.
